headline: OpenAI updates ChatGPT desktop app with GPT Voice mode for talking through work
summary: The ChatGPT desktop app now supports voice interactions, allowing users to speak their queries and receive spoken responses.
details: OpenAI has rolled out a significant update to its ChatGPT desktop application, introducing a highly anticipated GPT Voice mode.
This new feature enables users to engage with ChatGPT through spoken conversations, rather than solely relying on text input.
Users can now speak their questions or prompts and receive audio-based responses, making the interaction more dynamic and natural.
The update aims to enhance productivity by allowing users to talk through tasks and receive assistance in a hands-free manner.
This functionality was previously available on mobile devices and is now being extended to the desktop experience.
The integration of GPT Voice mode signifies OpenAI's continued effort to make AI interactions more accessible and conversational.

headline_marked: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with [[more capable models]] and app integration
headline: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models and app integration
summary: Claude's voice mode now supports Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models and can connect to apps like Gmail and Slack.
details: Anthropic has updated Claude's voice mode to support its more capable Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models, a significant upgrade from the previous Haiku-only version. This enhancement allows for more complex conversations and tasks.

The updated voice mode now defaults to the fastest version of the last model used in text chat. This allows users to engage in longer conversations, receive feedback on communication styles, discuss pitches, and brainstorm product market research.

A key new feature is Claude's ability to integrate with other applications such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Canva, and Notion. Users can now ask Claude to perform actions like updating meeting slots, drafting emails, or creating documents directly within these apps.

This integration capability sets Claude apart from competitors like OpenAI's voice mode, which currently lacks the ability to interact with external tools. This makes Claude a more versatile assistant for productivity tasks.

Anthropic has also expanded multilingual support to its voice mode, now available in beta. Users can converse in English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazilian), and Spanish (Latin America/Spain), though languages must be manually specified.
The new voice mode is available to all users in beta across platforms. Free users will be limited to the Haiku model and can only connect one app at a time.
